dataset.corpus: music21 9.9.2 Bach chorale soprano; J. S. Bach; metadata Riemenschneider/BWV
dataset.corpus_distribution: Local use only; no score encodings or corpus event files committed
dataset.prior_test_exclusions: No prior source-level split metadata in repository; separate experiment, no cross-dataset test comparison
dataset.duplicate_safeguards: Union same BWV work or normalized hymn title BEFORE score access; deduplicate source editions; remove exact normalized validation/training duplicates
limitations: Unknown cross-title near duplicates may remain; test scores remain unopened
Only fully representable major 4/4 or 2/2 pieces retained; strong selection bias
Whole contiguous complete-bar passages retained; pickups/end partial bars explicitly trimmed
No forced cadence or note repair; expression boundaries are metadata, not phrase labels learned by the model
